_readme: Sylius pack knowledge. STABLE: the source-side conventions (Symfony bundle layout, config/bundles.php as the activation authority, the Sylius resource-override mechanism, state-machine graph names) change only with a major version. SEED: the two target lists were derived from general Sylius/API Platform knowledge - re-verify every /api/v2 path and operation against the project's exact Sylius minor, because the API was rebuilt on API Platform and operations differ per version. `target_content_component_types` is deliberately honest: core has no CMS, so most entries are either commerce data that carries content or a third-party plugin's types. `standard_units` stays empty: derived per project from vendor/sylius.

entry_point_patterns.storefront: controller in src/Controller (or a bundle's Controller/) routed via config/routes*.yaml; Sylius resource controllers configured through sylius.resource routing (`type: sylius.resource`)
entry_point_patterns.api: API Platform resource: an entity or DTO with #[ApiResource] attributes / a Resources/config/api_resources/*.xml definition, plus its state providers/processors (or legacy data providers/persisters)
entry_point_patterns.admin: an admin controller plus a sylius_grid definition, and a menu entry added through a MenuBuilderEvent subscriber
entry_point_patterns.subscriber: class implementing EventSubscriberInterface listening on sylius.* resource events, kernel events or Doctrine lifecycle events
entry_point_patterns.state_machine: winzou_state_machine (or Symfony Workflow) callback service referenced from the graph configuration
entry_point_patterns.queue: Symfony Messenger handler (#[AsMessageHandler] or messenger.message_handler tag)
entry_point_patterns.console: Symfony console command (#[AsCommand]) - check whether a cron entry actually calls it
entry_point_patterns.form: a Sylius form type override via resource configuration, or a FormTypeExtension on a Sylius form

override_patterns.resource_override: sylius_<bundle>: resources: <resource>: classes: {model|controller|factory|repository|form} - the sanctioned override mechanism, look here FIRST
override_patterns.service_decoration: services.yaml `decorates:` or #[AsDecorator] wrapping a Sylius service
override_patterns.service_replacement: a service definition re-declaring an existing Sylius service id without decorating it - replaces outright
override_patterns.entity_subclass: a Doctrine entity extending a Sylius model class (with a resource-class override pointing at it) - adds columns to the existing Sylius table; classify as extended when it only adds fields
override_patterns.twig_full_override: templates/bundles/SyliusShopBundle/** or SyliusAdminBundle/** at the same relative path - hides the Sylius template, upgrade debt
override_patterns.twig_hook: Twig Hooks configuration (2.x) adding a block at a named insertion point - the maintainable variant, classify as extended
override_patterns.grid_override: sylius_grid configuration replacing or extending an admin grid's fields, filters or actions
override_patterns.state_machine_override: winzou_state_machine configuration adding or replacing states, transitions or callbacks on a Sylius graph
override_patterns.core_patch: a modified file under vendor/sylius, or a project class declared inside the Sylius\ namespace - highest risk, name the file

deprecation_patterns: full Twig template overrides where a Twig Hook would do (2.x) - break on every storefront change
business logic in controllers or Twig templates instead of services
direct Doctrine QueryBuilder use in a controller instead of a repository method
bypassing the resource override mechanism (patched vendor classes, class_alias tricks, reflection)
order-lifecycle logic outside the state machine
usage of classes marked @internal or @deprecated in sylius/sylius (check UPGRADE-*.md for the target minor)
legacy Sylius API (pre API Platform /api endpoints) still being consumed
media stored on the local filesystem without a Flysystem adapter (blocks containerised hosting)
session-held state for storefront features (blocks a headless frontend)
non-idempotent import commands and configuration data inserted by migrations without a rollback path
integration_signals: an HTTP client (Guzzle/Symfony HttpClient) calling an ERP, PIM, CRM, tax or carrier service from a project service
Payum gateway configuration and custom payment gateway factories
Symfony Messenger transports (AMQP/Doctrine/Redis) used as an integration buffer
a project console command consuming CSV/XML feeds
API Platform operations added purely for an external system
source_content_component_pattern: no core CMS entity - look for a CMS plugin's tables and templates instead (BitBag CMS plugin: cms Page / Block / Media / Section / FrequentlyAskedQuestion), for Taxon descriptions and images used as category content, for product attributes and rich-text product descriptions, and for hard-coded editorial content inside Twig templates under templates/bundles/SyliusShopBundle (a frequent finding and a migration cost)
target_api_endpoint_families: /api/v2/shop/products and /api/v2/shop/products/{code} (catalog read, incl. translations and images)
/api/v2/shop/orders/{tokenValue}/items and /items/{id} (add, change quantity, remove line items)
/api/v2/shop/adjustments and order totals as part of the order representation (no separate pricing endpoint)
GraphQL endpoint (API Platform can expose GraphQL, but it is not enabled or supported by default in Sylius) *(verify)*
target_content_component_types: core: NO CMS - Sylius Standard ships no page, block or content entity and no page builder
core content-bearing: Taxon (translated name, description, slug, images) as category content
core content-bearing: Product translations (name, short description, description) and Product attributes
core content-bearing: ProductImage / TaxonImage / ProductAssociation (media and merchandising)
core content-bearing: Channel settings (theme, hostname, contact details, menu taxon, colour/logo)
core content-bearing: ShopBillingData and legal/contact text fields on the channel
core: email template (Twig) per Sylius mail type - transactional content
core: Twig template override under templates/bundles/SyliusShopBundle (content placed in code - a migration cost, not a CMS)
core (2.x): Twig Hook insertion point - the sanctioned place to add content blocks to the storefront
core: sylius_grid definition (admin-side presentation, not storefront content)
plugin (BitBag CMS): Block (text, image, product/collection reference)
plugin (community): rich-editor / WYSIWYG field content on entities
external: headless CMS entries (Contentful, Strapi, Storyblok) composed in the frontend
custom: project content entity plus admin grid and API Platform resource (development effort in every estimate)

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
